title: Budget whole device blocks before asking QEMU
subtitle: Example: boot 512 MiB / desired 514 MiB / applied guest capacity 513 MiB / device blocks 2 MiB
note: Source/wire regression at c91da70. Reserved address space and guest onlining remain separate from the request budget.

lines: Only 1 MiB remains available for growth
Round 1 MiB up to one 2 MiB block
QEMU request: 514 MiB / reported current: 513 MiB
Request exceeds the checked capacity by 1 MiB

boxes.kicker: AFTER / CHECK THE ACTUAL WHOLE BLOCKS
lines: Keep the guest request at 512 MiB
Wait for applied capacity of 514 MiB
Then request exactly one 2 MiB block
A desired 513 MiB from a 512 MiB boot uses controlled restart, which can apply that exact boot size.
